author: Flebula
body:
I joined Avicus/McZone 7 months ago. This was the first time Minecraft ever became seriously addicting. At first I wanted to stop being so addicted but I decided the whole community of Avicus is doing me good. I found out the forums 1 month later and that is when I knew Avicus isn't just a server, it is a family.

Everyone on the whole Network (Unless they are trolls) is so kind and supportive and will care if you leave, or you just need a few tips. The server is full of truly original ideas and truly amazing people. Even when I rage behind then scenes or not behind the scenes I am having fun. I get so into the game, that when I don't fit in with the other players PvP wise I think I'm the odd one out. But I am not because The Avicus Family will support you with the ups or downs no matter what.

I would like to give a special thanks to the staff Howsie22, Jozzmcozz, Glitchy1, 1Theodore1, Evocal, DoctaPop, SweetMango and much, much more that I could't think of at the time. Without all staff, The Avicus Family would not be here. You guys provide so much happiness in my life and I can not thank you enough. 

The whole community is amazing and I am just letting you know you have made my life A LOT better. 
I thank you for everything

-MiningFlamingo
